About.metaTitle: About | Mai Phuong Resort Phu Quoc
About.metaDescription: Mai Phuong Resort on Phu Quoc Island: the resort story, location, island highlights, and shared amenities.
About.heroAria: About Mai Phuong Resort Phu Quoc
About.heroImageAlt: White sand and clear water on a tropical island
About.heroLead: Mai Phuong Resort on Pearl Island: a slower stay by the sea, with rooms, dining, spa, and day trips around Phu Quoc.
About.storyTitle: A place to pause on Pearl Island
About.storyBody: Mai Phuong Resort sits on Phu Quoc in Kien Giang — Vietnam's largest island, known for white sand, clear water, and a large national-park forest inside the Kien Giang Biosphere Reserve.
About.storyBodySecond: The resort is paced for quiet days: bright rooms, outdoor seating, and sea light from morning to evening. Guests rest on the grounds, eat local seafood, then add island tours, snorkeling, or park tickets when they want to go out.
About.storyBodyThird: Copy and photos on this page are a working draft set in Phu Quoc. When the resort provides its official story, address, and images, the text and pictures can be replaced without changing the layout.
About.factIslandValue: Phu Quoc, Kien Giang — Vietnam's largest island, with about 150 km of coastline.
About.factParkValue: Much of the island belongs to Phu Quoc National Park within a UNESCO-recognized biosphere reserve.
About.factCoastValue: Sao Beach, Kem Beach, and the An Thoi islands for swimming, snorkeling, and day boat trips.
About.factSeasonValue: Roughly November to April brings calmer seas and clearer skies for beach days and outdoor tours.
About.placeTitle: Private grounds among trees and sea air
About.placeBody: Paths lead from the rooms to the pool, restaurants, and quiet corners. Spaces stay open so guests can sit longer, read, or watch the water after a morning by the sea.
About.placeBodySecond: In the evening, guests can dine on property or head to nearby beach streets when they want a livelier pace. Detailed on-site amenities will be added once official resort content is ready.
About.placeImageAlt: A tropical resort pool under palm trees
About.locationTitle: On Phu Quoc, close to beaches and day trips
About.locationBody: From Mai Phuong Resort, guests can reach southern beaches such as Sao and Kem, boat out to the An Thoi islands for coral snorkeling, or head north into the national park. Phu Quoc International Airport makes arriving on the island straightforward before the transfer to the resort.
About.locationBodySecond: The exact address, map, and directions will be added when the resort confirms details. The Contact page will show the official phone, email, and wayfinding information.
About.locationImageAlt: A tropical shoreline with white sand and blue water
About.highlightsAria: What to know about Phu Quoc
About.highlightsTitle: Sea, forest, and the taste of Phu Quoc
About.highlightsLead: Beyond the Mai Phuong Resort grounds, Pearl Island offers many same-day experiences. The notes below set the context; the resort will later update photos and captions in Destinations / tours / tickets.
About.highlightBeachesText: Two white-sand beaches on the southeast coast, with shallow water and gentle waves — ideal for swimming, beach cafes, or a full quiet day in the sun.
About.highlightBeachesImageAlt: White sand beach facing clear blue water
About.highlightNatureTitle: National park and the An Thoi islands
About.highlightNatureText: The north holds national-park forest with trekking routes and waterfalls. The south opens to small islands around An Thoi — popular for snorkeling, coral viewing, and seafood on the boat.
About.highlightNatureImageAlt: Clear blue water seen from above
About.highlightFoodTitle: Seafood, pepper, and Phu Quoc fish sauce
About.highlightFoodText: The island is known for fresh seafood, Phu Quoc pepper, and traditional fish sauce. On property, dining will lean local; nearby night markets and beach restaurants add more options.
About.amenitiesTitle: What Mai Phuong Resort already covers
About.amenitiesLead: The items below follow the confirmed website menu. Photos, opening hours, and longer descriptions will be filled in by the resort later.
About.amenityRoomsText: Room types with capacity and introductory rates. Guests review photos and descriptions, then continue to booking on the website.
About.amenityDiningText: Meals on the grounds with a focus on seafood and Phu Quoc flavors. Opening hours and signature dishes will be updated later.
About.amenitySpaText: A quiet spa space after beach days or forest walks, with restorative treatments for guests staying on property.
About.amenityOutdoorsText: A pool, seating areas, and tree-lined paths for pauses between meals or before an island tour.
About.amenityToursText: Same-day journeys around Phu Quoc — beaches, forest, craft villages, or small islands — with photos managed by resort staff.
About.amenityTicketsText: Ticket details for island visits and activities, shown with destinations and tours.
About.ctaTitle: Browse rooms and reserve on the website
About.ctaBody: From this overview, guests can view room types or send a booking request at Mai Phuong Resort Phu Quoc. Connecting live inventory to the PMS will come later, once the API docs are ready.
